hook: Hoffman co-founded LinkedIn, which launched in 2003, after early roles at Apple, SocialNet and PayPal, and has been a partner at Greylock since 2009. He was among OpenAI's first financial backers and sat on its board until March 2023, and he has since co-founded two AI companies, Inflection AI in 2022 and the drug discovery startup Manas AI in 2025. He serves on Microsoft's board and has written about AI in the books Impromptu and Superagency.
name: Reid Hoffman

quote.text: My current priority is investing in and building with AI to benefit humanity.
quote.context: Reid Hoffman, biography on his website, reidhoffman.org

moniker: Co-founder of LinkedIn, Inflection AI and Manas AI, Partner at Greylock

Begins investing in early-stage technology companies.

timeline.impact: Becomes one of OpenAI's initial funders.

quick_facts: Studied symbolic systems and cognitive science at Stanford and philosophy at Oxford as a Marshall Scholar.
Was executive vice president of PayPal and a member of its founding board.
Co-founded LinkedIn, launched in 2003, which Microsoft agreed to acquire in 2016.
Has been a partner at Greylock since 2009 and a member of Microsoft's board since March 2017.
Co-founded Inflection AI in 2022 and Manas AI, an AI drug discovery company, in January 2025 with cancer researcher Siddhartha Mukherjee.
Hosts the podcasts Masters of Scale and Possible.

achievements.title: Co-founder, LinkedIn
achievements.impact: Co-founded the professional network in 2002, launched it in 2003, and served as executive chairman. Greylock describes it as having more than one billion members.

achievements.title: Partner, Greylock
achievements.impact: Has invested in early-stage technology companies at Greylock since joining as a partner in 2009.

achievements.title: Early backer and board member, OpenAI
achievements.impact: Named among OpenAI's financial backers in its December 2015 founding announcement, later joined its board, and resigned on March 3, 2023, citing a wish to avoid conflicts of interest.

achievements.title: Co-founder, Inflection AI
achievements.impact: Co-founded the AI company in 2022 with Mustafa Suleyman and Karen Simonyan. In March 2024 Microsoft licensed its technology and hired Suleyman and most of its staff.

achievements.title: Co-founder, Manas AI
achievements.impact: Launched the AI drug discovery company in January 2025 with Siddhartha Mukherjee, applying AI from target identification through clinical trials.

source_basis: This profile was written mainly from the Wikipedia article on Reid Hoffman, retrieved 2026-10-22, with awards, dates and current roles checked against Greylock's team page, his own website, Microsoft's board listing and Manas AI's site.
